name: Observatory
pitch: A data-heavy infrastructure talk, charted like a night sky: systems as bodies, readings taken through a reticle.

illustration.medium: flat vector, night-sky astronomical illustration on deep navy
illustration.line: 2px strokes, thin orbital rings and constellation lines
illustration.shapes: circles, rings, and dotted orbital paths, radial composition around a focal point
illustration.texture: subtle star-field dots scattered in the background
illustration.palette_use: deep navy background dominant, soft amber accent used for the focal point or highlight, pale blue for secondary line work
illustration.avoid: gradients used heavily, bright multi-color palettes, hard-edged UI chrome, clutter
